[EN] Mission Orders

The Lokians are still up to the same old tricks.

Destroy the {@LinkCreature:25#3011#consecrated Lokians}, {@LinkCreature:25#3012#shurian champions}, {@LinkCreature:25#3021#primal Lokians}, {@LinkCreature:25#3022#shurian magisters}, {@LinkCreature:25#3031#primal Lokian darkweavers}, and {@LinkCreature:25#3032#hallowed Lokian knights}.

Report to Coordinator Delwen when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Los Lokians siguen con sus viejos trucos.

Destruye a los {@LinkCreature:25#3011#consecrated Lokians}, {@LinkCreature:25#3012#shurian champions}, {@LinkCreature:25#3021#primal Lokians}, {@LinkCreature:25#3022#shurian magisters}, {@LinkCreature:25#3031#primal Lokian darkweavers} y {@LinkCreature:25#3032#hallowed Lokian knights}.

Preséntate ante la coordinadora Delwen cuando termines la misión.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
